newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trichet- as interested as Germany in stable Euro.
newsitem.headline: Trichet- as interested as Germany in stable Euro.

text.p: Bank of France Governor Jean-Claude said on Thursday he is as interested as Germany in a stable Euro and that it would be a mistake for some countries to enter into currency union unprepared.

"Premature entry of countries whose economies have not sufficiently converged would undermine the credibility of the Euro...it would be a mistake for a country to join too soon, whose economy was not prepared," Trichet told the German association of savings banks.

Trichet said the result of premature entry into EMU would be a loss of competitiveness and inflation, adding that France wants "a Euro as credible, as stable, as the Franc, and as credible and as stable as the mark."

Trichet said EMU must be based on solid foundations and must be implemented on the basis of sound technical criteria and said that EMU is the final structural barrier to creating the world's largest single market ahead of the U.S. and Japan.
